#!/usr/bin/env python3
# Sample module used by the lint tests.
# It shows each case the rules must handle.
"""Module docstring fails."""
import os

URL = "https://example.com/#anchor"
HASH = "# not a comment"
TRIPLE = """
# still a string
"""


def documented():
    """Function docstring fails."""
    return os.sep  # trailing fails


class Documented:
    # comment before docstring fails
    """Class docstring fails."""

    def method(self):
        value = "text"
        "a bare string later is not a docstring"
        return value


def suppressed():
    a = 1  # noqa: F841
    b: int = "x"  # type: ignore[assignment]
    c = b  # pyright: ignore
    return a, c


# standalone fails
F = f"{URL}#frag"
